description: Web crawling, scraping, search and interaction API for AI agents and developers
access_requirements: Free tier self-serve (1,000 free credits, no card required)
evidence_excerpts: "Click on the dashboard button on the top navigation menu when logged in and you will find your API key in the main screen and under API Keys."
"Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required."
"You can also call the REST API directly from any language."
"Firecrawl has an official MCP server so agents in Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, and other MCP‑compatible tools can search, scrape, and interact with the web directly."
"Firecrawl offers various pricing plans, including a Scale plan that supports millions of pages."
